name: Container for nx-scv development
summary: Define a container that developers can use to work with nx-scv monorepo

rawActions.name: Container is based on Node24 Debian/Ubuntu
Create Dockerfile at monorepo root
rawActions.summary: Base image node:24 (Debian bookworm). Copy package manifests first for layer caching, run npm install, then copy source.

rawActions.name: Create scripts/container-build.sh
rawActions.summary: Shell script to build the nx-scv-dev container image: container build -t nx-scv-dev . Make executable with chmod +x.

rawActions.name: Create scripts/container-shell.sh
rawActions.summary: Shell script for interactive dev shell with workspace mounted: container run -it --rm -v $(pwd):/workspace nx-scv-dev bash. Make executable with chmod +x.

rawActions.name: Create scripts/container-test.sh
rawActions.summary: Shell script to run tests inside container: container run --rm -v $(pwd):/workspace nx-scv-dev npm run test. Make executable with chmod +x.

rawActions.name: Add npm scripts to package.json
rawActions.summary: Add short npm script entries that delegate to scripts/: container:build, container:shell, container:test
